buses.help: Bus types to probe, comma-separated, e.g. can

mode.help: passive observes/classifies only; active also injects probes; both does both

probe_id.help: CAN ID used for active probe injection, hex (0x..) or decimal

echo_timeout_ticks.help: Ticks to wait for a probe echo before considering it lost

report_period_ticks.help: Ticks between periodic stderr summary reports
